messages:
lucy: Quick heads-up — kicking off an ops + legal sync for the new open-model supplier (AsterAI) we're onboarding. Need to align on export controls, redistribution constraints, and marketplace packaging. Can folks who own these areas chime in?
vikram: thanks lucy. heads up: HW partner (FalconCloud) wants a joint listing in their marketplace and a co-marketing blurb. we need to confirm redistribution rights and any geo blocks.
olivia-legal: high level: we need the model's license text + source provenance. primary flags: export control (ECCN?), dual-use language, and any non-transferrable clauses. do we have the model repo link?
sara: i have the model manifest from AsterAI. link: https://aster.ai/models/nebula-v1 (cc: @olivia-legal). it mentions "non-commercial research" in one place and a separate commercial license offer. confusing.
olivia-legal: ok that signals we likely need a signed commercial redistribution addendum. please share the exact manifest file.
james: infra note: marketplace listing will want a quantized runtime artifact (int8) we can host. need vendor permission for distributing quantized weights. some licenses forbid derivative distribution.
lucy: @james exactly — FalconCloud wants a downloadable package so customers can spin up in their marketplace image. if license forbids derivatives, we may instead provide a hosted image link.
ethan-sec: security point: if we host binaries for marketplace, we need SBOM + provenance so customers can verify integrity. also check export controls for model checkpoints (some countries restrict).
vikram: commercial ask from FalconCloud: "joint listing + logo + marketplace banner". marketing needs an approved blurb. sara can draft, but legal sign-off required.
sara: drafting now. propose callout: "Redwood x FalconCloud: easy deploy of Nebula-v1 (commercial) — backed by Redwood inference runtime". will keep TBD items as placeholders.
olivia-legal: do not use model name without confirming licensing. also need to avoid implying endorsement of the open-source variant until redistribution cleared.
james: ops question: if we can't redistribute quantized weights, could we provide an OCI image that pulls weights at runtime from AsterAI's CDN? that would keep us from distributing artifacts.
olivia-legal: that could mitigate redistribution risk but doesn't avoid export controls. still need to verify allowed geos and get ECCN info from vendor.
lucy: action items so far: 1) sara share draft blurb (in thread) 2) jamo (james) to enumerate hosting options (hosted artifact vs runtime-only) 3) olivia to request license addendum + ECCN from AsterAI 4) ethan assemble SBOM/attestation checklist.
vikram: timeline: FalconCloud wants a go/no-go in 10 business days for marketplace slot. is that feasible?
sara: i'll push a draft within 24h.
james: i'll run feasibility matrix today — will post small matrix: [hosted image, OCI runtime image, hosted API only] with pros/cons.
olivia-legal: i'll send a short checklist to AsterAI legal. sample ask:
```
- canonical license file
- explicit redistribution permission for quantized/derived weights
- ECCN/export control classification
- territorial restrictions (if any)
- indemnity/TOU for marketplace listing
```
please don't share public draft yet.
ethan-sec: i'll add SBOM template and required attestations. also will flag if model training data contains regulated data types.
lucy: +1. one more: check SI partners (Systems Integrators) — some need on-prem packages. if license forbids offline redistribution, on-prem installs could be blocked. add to matrix.
vikram: noted. thanks everyone. can we have a short sync tomorrow 11am PT? 20min to unblock FalconCloud timelines.
sara: works for me.
james: ok.
olivia-legal: can do 11am. sending calendar invite.
deploy-bot: Deployment report: marketplace-slot-req created (#MP-4127) — ETA: 10d. :robot_face:
lucy: thanks — will collate these threads into a single checklist doc after call and share with AsterAI contact.
vikram: i'll prepare a short risk slide (legal/export/ops) for FalconCloud PO. thanks all. :thumbsup:
